instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Answer in edits mode with small exact {search, replace} edits (do NOT return the whole file). 3 tests fail: (1) 'deletes a page via the menu' -> expected null not to be null: openTabMenu() (line ~69) queries [data-testid='pages-tab-menu-trigger'] but PagesTabBar.tsx renders data-testid="pages-menu-trigger"; and the delete item is queried as [data-testid='pages-menu-delete'] (lines ~175, ~191 and in the view-mode test ~402) but PagesTabBar.tsx renders data-testid="page-menu-delete": replace those two id strings everywhere in the file. (2) 'keeps undo on its page' line ~324-337 -> expected 1 to be 0: the test seeds with API.setElements([r1, r2]) which writes elements without updating the store snapshot, so the first arrow-key capture records 'r1 added, r2 added, r1 moved' as one undo entry; seed instead with `API.updateScene({ elements: [r1, r2], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER })` (import CaptureUpdateAction from "@excalidraw/element"; history.test.tsx seeds this way). Keep the assertions. (3) 'finds text on another page and switches to it' line ~380 -> activePageId stays 'default': SearchMenu only auto-focuses matches on the current page, so after the match count is 1 press Enter in the search input (`fireEvent.keyDown(searchInput, { key: KEYS.ENTER })`) before `await waitFor(() => expect(h.state.activePageId).toBe(p2Id))`.
